errors.text_span: The VideoLLAVA series is drawn in purple with circular markers and a solid line
errors.evidence: According to the reference and the image, VideoLLAVA is drawn with a dashed style, not a solid line.

errors.text_span: rising steeply from about 20–30 GB at very low frame counts (near the left edge) to about 65 GB around 64 frames
errors.evidence: The reference indicates VideoLLAVA starts at slightly above 10 GB. The machine-generated description says 20-30 GB at very low frame counts. Looking at the image, the starting values for all lines appear to be around 20-30 GB which is plausible, but the value of ~65 GB at 64 frames appears inconsistent with the image where at ~64 frames VideoLLAVA appears to be around 65 GB which seems reasonable.

errors.text_span: then reaching beyond the top of the plotted y-range (above 400 GB) by roughly 320 frames
errors.evidence: The reference states that VideoLLAVA goes beyond the graph range between 200 and 300 frames. The image shows the line going off-chart between approximately 250-300 frames, not at 320 frames.

The description does not mention that the y-axis tick labels are at intervals of 50 GB (50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400), though it does list them individually. More importantly, it does not note the dashed style of the VideoLLAVA line, which is a distinctive visual feature.
